<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="he" dir="rtl">
  <head>
    <meta charset="utf-8">
    <title>הגישה לדף אינה מורשית - מערך הדיגיטל הלאומי</title>
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
    <style>
        @import url('https://fonts.cdnfonts.com/css/rubik');
        body, div, p, h1, h2, h3, span, strong, img, a { width: 100%; margin: 0 auto; padding: 0; border: 0; display: block; position: relative; text-align: center; font-weight: normal; font-size: 14px; overflow: hidden; }
        span, strong, img { display: inline; width: auto; }
        body { font-family: 'Rubik', Arial, Verdana, Helvetica, sans-serif; background-color: #F7FAFF; color: #0C3058; }
        a:focus { border: 2px solid #c00; }
        #container { max-width: 1200px; max-width: 90%; }
        #logo { display: flex; gap: 5px; flex-flow: row; position: absolute; top: 20px; right: 20px; max-width: 100px; z-index: 99; }
        #logo_image img { width: 39px; height: auto; }
        #logo_text span { display: block; font-size: 13px; line-height: 13px; }
        #main { margin-top: 30px; }
        @media screen and (max-width: 868px) { #main { margin-top: 80px; } }
        #main_image img { width: 617px; height: auto; max-width: 100%;}
        #main_text { margin-top: -32px; }
        @media screen and (max-width: 868px) { #main_text { margin-top: -12px; } }
        #main_text p, #main_text h1 { font-size: 36px; line-height: 40px; font-weight: 500; }
        @media screen and (max-width: 868px) { #main_text p, #main_text h1 { font-size: 22px; line-height: 36px; } }
        #main_proposal { margin-top: 24px; margin-bottom: 26px; max-width: 60%; }
        #main_proposal p, #main_proposal h2 { font-size: 20px; line-height: 20px; }
        @media screen and (max-width: 868px) { #main_proposal p, #main_proposal h2 { font-size: 18px; line-height: 18px; } }
        .btn { background-color: #0068F5; width: 120px; height: 16px; padding: 10px 16px; color: #FFFFFF; border-radius: 10px; text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; font-size: 16px; line-height: 16px; }
        @media screen and (max-width: 868px) { .btn { width: 150px; height: 20px; font-size: 20px; line-height: 20px; } }
    </style>
  </head>
  <body>
    <div id="logo">
        <div id="logo_image">
            <img width="39" height="40" src="data:image/png;base64," alt="מערך הדיגיטל הלאומי">
        </div>
        <div id="logo_text">
            <span>מערך</span>
            <span>הדיגיטל</span>
            <span>הלאומי</span>
        </div>
    </div>
    <div id="container">
        <div id="main" role="main">
            <div id="main_image">
                <img width="617" height="320" src="data:image/png;base64," alt="אין גישה לדף">
            </div>
            <div id="main_text">
                <h1>מדיניות הגלישה לא מאפשרת גישה לדף זה.</h1>
            </div>
            <div id="main_proposal">
                <h2>ניתן לפנות לאחראי המחשוב במשרד.</h2>
            </div>
			    <div class="xs-mb-10 txt">
                       <p>Adult&#x2F;Mature Content</p>
                        </div>
                        <div class="xs-mb-10 txt">
                       <p>147.237.70.147</p>
                        </div>
                        <div class="xs-mb-10 txt">
                       <p>Blocked By Category</p>
                        </div>
                        <div class="xs-mb-10 txt">
                       <p>10.20.170.110</p>
                        </div>
                        <div class="xs-mb-10 link-txt">
        </div>
    </div>
  </body>
</html>
